value.rationale: A physically natural magnetic multi-path interferometer has all hopping magnitudes fixed, yet changing only phases produces three sharply distinct transport regimes. The dense countable PST and non-PGST resonances interlace with a full-measure PGST regime; a 3:1 resonance has an explicit substantial 16/27 probability cap. The all-size formula and phase geometry are more informative than a routine single-graph calculation. This result concerns coherent infinite-time transfer, not noise-robust realizations.
